title: MULTITASK PROMPTED TRAINING ENABLES ZERO-SHOT TASK GENERALIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pronoun coreference resolution and textual entailment using minimal sentence pairs (WinoBias and WinoGender schemas), specifically by comparing the model's accuracy between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical examples to see if stereotypes lead the model astray.

bias_targets.target: U.S. stereotypical biases (including race, religion, age, socioeconomic status, etc.)
bias_targets.methodology: Formulating a classification task where the model must predict which of two sentences in a minimal pair illustrates a stereotype versus an anti-stereotype, using the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
